title.rendered: Arqaam Capital to partner with the Middle East Investor Relations Association and HSBC to deliver the Corporate Access Programme at the upcoming 2025 MEIRA Annual Conference

content.rendered:
We’re excited to partner with the Middle East Investor Relations Association and HSBC to deliver the Corporate Access Programme at the upcoming 2025 MEIRA Annual Conference, taking place on 24–25 September in Muscat, Oman.
Hosted in collaboration with the Muscat Stock Exchange S.A.O.C, MEIRA’s Annual Conference this is the largest gathering of Investor Relations and Capital Markets professionals in the Middle East – welcoming over 900 delegates in 2024 alone.
This year’s conference promises another standout edition, bringing together regional and international investors, issuers, regulators, and market leaders for two days of strategic dialogue, workshops, and investor engagement. As Corporate Access Partner and Platinum Sponsor, Arqaam Capital is proud to support MEIRA in its mission to elevate market transparency, access, and investor engagement across the region.
Venue: Oman Convention & Exhibition Centre
Dates: 24–25 September 2025

Register now: conf.meira.me

View More
